rules: Copy every V5 raw source and sidecar byte-for-byte into a new reversible rollback directory.
Copy every archived V5 review image byte-for-byte into the V17 review route; do not rerender, resample or re-encode it.
Rewrite URLs only. Preserve V5 cells, bounds, bays, anchors, interaction spots, states, frames, timing and projection metadata exactly.
Reject any V17 image or raw file whose SHA-256 differs from its V5 authority file.
V6 through V16 remain immutable rejected provenance and are not visual or geometry authorities.
Nothing is approved, promoted or wired into the live game.
